Sam H: Anyone else seeing the ferry cancellations this morning? Baylink site says 'suspended' due to high winds. https://ferrystatus.example.com :wind_face:
Vivian L: Yep got the alert — tempted to bike but gusts look rough. Might WFH instead.
Omar K: BART is moving but way more packed than usual at 7:15. Took the Dublin train, people standing.
Jen C: For folks coming to the office, I'm running the 7:45 Redwood shuttle from the HQ lot if anyone needs a seat. Reply here.
Mike R: @Jen C could use a lift if there's space — happy to chip for parking.
WeatherBot: Wind advisory in effect until 11:00. Peak gusts 35-45 mph. Small craft advisory for the bay. Plan alternatives if your commute uses ferries.
Sam H: Thanks @WeatherBot. Heads-up to managers: I'm leaning WFH today unless bridge looks calmer by 9.
Vivian L: I'll be remote too. Zoom still on at 10 for standup.
Omar K: parking near Embarcadero is tight, FYI. If anyone wants to carpool from SoMa I have one spare seat.
Jen C: @Omar K @Mike R great — Omar, can you swing by 5th & Mission around 8:00?
Mike R: Yep can do. Also FYI, Muni's bike racks on the bridge are closed because of debris reports.
Sam H: Meme incoming: "When you choose to kayak to work but forget you're not Aquaman" :joy: (posted GIF)
Jen C: Also, kitchen PSA: the big oat canister is empty. Emergency granola protocol activated. :crying_cat_face:
Vivian L: If anyone's driving through, grab oats. I'll Venmo.
Omar K: Appreciate the offers y'all. If anything changes I'll update this thread.
Mike R: Thanks everyone, safe travels.
Sam H: Keep the updates coming, especially if ferries resume or if any roads close. :thumbsup:
